jobs.title: Senior Associate, Investments UK, Ireland & Nordics (Real Estate)
jobs.description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

We have an outstanding benefits package which includes:
- Company-provided healthcare

- A competitive annual leave allowance

- Flexible working options, including hybrid working arrangements

- Generous pension provisions

- Income protection

- Health and wellness benefits

- Volunteering days

- Enhanced parental leave

- Life insurance

Your Role:
Are you passionate about real estate investing and excited by the opportunity to drive value creation across a high-quality residential portfolio?

We're looking for a Senior Associate, Real Estate Investments to join our London-based team!

In this highly visible role, you'll work closely with senior investment professionals to oversee a portfolio of residential assets, influence strategic decisions, and help deliver outstanding investment performance. This is an opportunity to take ownership of asset-level strategy, work on acquisitions and disposals, collaborate with industry-leading partners, and contribute directly to portfolio growth and long-term value creation.

Among your responsibilities:
As a Senior Associate, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping investment outcomes by:

Driving Asset Performance
- Develop and execute business plans that maximise asset value and performance.

- Lead strategic leasing initiatives, operational improvements, and capital projects.

- Partner with third-party property managers, consultants, and joint venture partners to deliver asset objectives.

Supporting Investment Decisions
- Conduct advanced financial modelling, valuation analysis, and investment underwriting.

- Review Argus and Excel models to support acquisitions, disposals, refinancing, and portfolio management decisions.

- Coordinate due diligence processes and work closely with internal and external stakeholders throughout transactions.

Delivering Strategic Insights
- Analyse property performance against budgets, forecasts, and market benchmarks.

- Identify risks and opportunities and provide recommendations that enhance returns and long-term value.

- Support quarterly valuations through robust financial and market analysis.

Leading Planning & Reporting
- Oversee asset budgeting, forecasting, and capital expenditure planning.

- Contribute to Annual Business Plans and portfolio strategy initiatives.

- Prepare insightful reporting for senior management and investment committees.

Staying Ahead of the Market
- Monitor market trends, leasing activity, and transaction evidence to support informed investment decisions.

- Translate market intelligence into actionable asset management strategies.

Championing ESG+R Initiatives
- Integrate sustainability and risk management objectives across the portfolio.

- Collaborate with partners and advisers to deliver ESG+R targets and regulatory requirements.

You'll need to have:
We're interested in candidates who combine strong analytical capability with commercial judgement and a proactive approach to problem solving.

- Significant experience within the real estate investment, asset management, or related property sector.

- Strong residential asset management experience, ideally complemented by investment or transactional exposure.

- Demonstrated success in developing and executing asset-level strategies that drive performance and value creation.

- Advanced financial modelling and analytical skills.

- Experience working with Argus, Yardi, and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

- Commercially minded with excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Strong understanding of valuation methodologies, lease structures, and key real estate performance metrics.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable working with senior decision-makers and influencing investment outcomes.

- Highly organised, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.

- Self-motivated and capable of operating independently while collaborating across teams.

- Degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

- Professional qualification such as MRICS, CFA, or progress towards qualification is advantageous.

- Commitment to continuous professional development.

Disability Confident Scheme:
Applicants who opt in to the Disability Confident Scheme and meet the criteria for the role will be offered an interview. We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process for all candidates who make an application. By opting-in to this scheme, applicants will be disclosing that they have a disability solely for the purpose of the Disability Confident Scheme.
The Disability Confident Scheme only guarantees an interview – it does not automatically mean that applicants interviewed will gain employment with Invesco at that time.
To apply through the Disability Confident Scheme, you’ll need to firstly ensure you have applied for the role via our external careers page. Following this, you’ll need to email us at emea-talentacquisition@invesco.com confirming your wish to opt-in, alongside your contact details and the title of the role you wish to apply for.

Full Time / Part Time

Full time
Worker Type

Employee
Job Exempt (Yes / No)

Yes

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in the role's advertised office. Invesco is seeking a Associate Product Manager to support a group of investment products across our Fundamental Equities franchise. The Product Manager is responsible for supporting a set of equities investment strategies and will maintain critical connectivity with CPMs and portfolio teams, enabling alignment on product positioning, messaging, internal sales needs, portfolio data, and other potential issues to ensure strategic priorities are met. - Monitor industry and product trends: compile, analyze, and interpret data to inform product strategy and prioritization.
- Conduct competitive and peer analysis using Morningstar, eVestment, and related resources to help support CPMs with product positioning and go-to-market workflow.
-

The CPM is regarded as a credible investment professionals who acts as the primary interface between our client-facing resources and the investment team. The CPM interacts with the portfolio management team daily to understand historical and current portfolio positioning, market conditions and portfolio themes. The CPM is able to communicate performance attribution, the rationale for specific holdings and portfolio activity, risk attributes, and views of the team clearly and succinctly to a variety of institutional clients and institutional / retail stakeholders. The CPM will maintain detailed knowledge of the competitive landscape/peer group, stay current on market trends and developments in all relevant distribution channels, and be able to clearly articulate what differentiates our products from the competition. - Grow and retain business by representing the investment team and key investment strategies to clients.

- Service existing clients via in-person meetings (on- and off-site), conference calls and board / investment committee meetings, as needed in place of Portfolio Managers, or in support of them.

- Provide end-to-end client servicing such that institutional clients’ needs are met with the same high standards they come to expect with Invesco products.

- Regularly reflect the investment team by communicating existing (and potential) investment strategies to clients. Provide portfolio updates and insights to drive client engagement and loyalty.

- Drive the development of research, presentations and investment insights for clients. This includes monitoring key investment and industry trends, working with the thought leadership team to identifytopics that resonate with investors. This individual will leverage publications, speaking engagements, public relations and marketing channels to drive key messages into the market.

- Attend and present at industry and client conferences including Invesco roundtables, industry events, and PR opportunities.

Secondary Responsibilities / Duties:
- Play a key role in developing institutional and wealth opportunities by working with the distribution teams to educate consultants, investment platform gatekeepers and prospects on investment grade and high yield investment strategies.

- Develop and modify collateral including Finals presentations, DDQs, RFPs and due diligence meeting presentations as needed.

- Build strong relationships with the Distribution teams supporting their efforts to execute an effective sales strategy.

- Experience working with investment platform research analysts, field level financial advisors, retirement plan gatekeepers, investment consultants and/or institutional investment committees for corporations, public entities, and/or endowments and foundations.

Job Description

About Invesco Real Estate
Invesco Real Estate is a global real estate investment management business with $88.9 billion in real estate assets under management, 574 employees and 21 regional offices across the U.S., Europe and Asia (as of March 31, 2026). Invesco Real Estate was established in 1983 and today invests across the risk return spectrum, from core to opportunistic; in equity and debt; listed and direct; locally and globally. Invesco Real Estate is a business name of Invesco Advisers, Inc., an indirect, wholly owned subsidiary of Invesco Ltd. Invesco Ltd. is an independent investment management firm dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. NYSE: IVZ; http://www.invesco.com/realestate .

About Invesco Ltd.
Invesco Ltd. (Ticker NYSE: IVZ) is a global independent investment management firm dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. Our distinctive investment teams deliver a comprehensive range of active, passive, and alternative investment capabilities. With offices in more than 20 countries, Invesco managed US$2.4 trillion in assets on behalf of clients worldwide as of June 30, 2026.

About the Role:
The Senior Analyst partners with Investment Managers in the management and oversight of various commercial and residential real estate investments, with the overall goal of optimizing asset performance and values. The Senior Analyst plays an integral role in developing and executing property specific strategies, analyzing major leasing decisions and how they impact value, performing major feasibility studies and evaluating property level performance against relevant industry benchmarks.  In addition, the role is responsible for providing support and analysis for the preparation of the quarterly and annual property reports and budgets for a portfolio of assets.

Responsibilities of the Role:
- Work with Investment Manager to create property level operational strategies and analyze major leases, capital projects or other investment factors impacting asset value.

- Assist in the review of valuation models (Argus and Excel) and take part in the acquisition and disposition process, overseeing the flow of due diligence information for select investments as needed.

- Prepare financial analysis to track historic portfolio and property level results in comparison to industry benchmarks.

- Coordinate the development of Annual Business Plans and Quarterly reports by assisting in the preparation of property operating and capital budgets and reviewing and approving on-going financial variance reporting.

- Communicate with third party property management and leasing personnel as well as insurance and real estate tax consultants and other third-party providers as needed.

- Review lease submittal packages, evaluate prospective tenant businesses and credit worthiness, and perform other lease related financial analysis as needed.

- Collect, analyze and synthesize relevant market reports and other lease or transaction related data.

- Help facilitate lender compliance with asset specific requirements such as obtaining approvals for lease agreements or significant capital expenditure projects and coordinating the release of escrow accounts.

- Support enforcement of internal audit requirements with third party providers and further ensure that such firms are conducting business in accordance with property management agreements.

- Some travel will be required for periodic asset management-related property visits and select acquisition due diligence.

Requirements for the Role:
- Four year or equivalent undergraduate degree in Business or related field. Post graduate education a plus.  A commitment to continued education in real estate will be encouraged.

- 1 - 3 years of experience in the commercial and/or multi-family real estate industry (or business related activity) is required.

- Property level experience is a plus.

- Effective interpersonal, communication (verbal and written) and listening skills.

- Strong computer literacy; experience with AI, Argus, VTS, RealPage, Microsoft Excel and Word, and PowerPoint is a plus.

- Ability to understand and interpret present value concepts and financial terminology.

- Analytical problem solving skills capable to undertake detailed analyses and make well-reasoned, decisive recommendations.

- Demonstrated prioritization, organization and time management skills necessary to balance competing deadlines.

- Desire to multi-task in a complex, high-volume environment and competency to work with all levels of management and personnel on critical projects.

The total compensation offered for this position, which includes salary and incentive pay, will vary based on skills, experience and location. The salary range for this position in San Francisco is $90,000 to $115,000 annually.
